items.exampleCN: 他的志向是在山里教书。

items.example: The brochure was aspirational, not literal.
items.exampleCN: 这本宣传册是在引发向往，而非写实。

items.example: Children aspirate the first consonant too strongly.
items.exampleCN: 孩子们把第一个辅音送气送得太重。

items.example: The valley inspired the whole score.
items.exampleCN: 这条山谷激发了整部乐曲。

definition_zh: n. 混合物；混合体；汞合金（尤指补牙用的银汞合金）
definition_en: A mixture or blend of different elements; also an alloy of mercury with another metal, especially the paste used in dental fillings.
core_image: 几种不同的东西被揉成看不出原样的一团
scene: 这家餐馆把川菜和粤菜混在一起，味道反倒很协调。 The menu is an amalgam of two regional styles.
sceneCN: 第 2 个义项：菜单不是单一菜系，而是两种地方风格揉在一起的混合体。这正是 amalgam 的引申用法。

senses.title: A blend of different things
senses.definition: a thing made by combining several different elements so that they no longer stand apart
senses.definitionCN: 把若干不同成分结合起来、使它们不再各自分立而成的东西
senses.example: The film is an amalgam of comedy and grief.
senses.exampleCN: 这部电影是喜剧与悲伤的混合体。
senses.why: The word began as a soft metallic paste that could be worked by hand, so the image is of separate pieces kneaded into one mass.
senses.whyCN: 这个词最初指可用手揉捏的软金属膏，所以意象是把分散的碎块揉成一团。

senses.title: A mercury alloy
senses.definition: an alloy of mercury with another metal, especially the silver paste used to fill teeth
senses.definitionCN: 汞与另一种金属形成的合金，尤指用于补牙的银汞膏
senses.example: The dentist replaced the old amalgam with resin.
senses.exampleCN: 牙医用树脂替换了旧的银汞合金。
senses.why: Alchemists needed a metal that stayed soft enough to shape, and mercury supplied it; the technical sense is the older one.
senses.whyCN: 炼金术士需要一种保持柔软、便于塑形的金属，汞提供了这一点；技术义是更古老的那个义项。

intro.en: Amalgam comes from Greek malagma, a softening poultice, through Arabic al-malgham and Medieval Latin amalgama. The soft paste of the workshop became any blend at all.
intro.cn: amalgam 来自希腊语 malagma「软化膏」，经阿拉伯语 al-malgham 与中世纪拉丁语 amalgama 而来。作坊里的软膏后来变成泛指任何混合物。

items.en: Greek malagma meant a softening poultice, from malassein, to soften. The base idea is a soft mass worked by hand until it spreads.
items.cn: 希腊语 malagma 意为「软化用的膏药」，来自 malassein「使变软」。基本想法是一团用手揉到能摊开的软物质。

items.en: Arabic al-malgham carried the term into alchemy for a soft paste of mercury mixed with another metal.
items.cn: 阿拉伯语 al-malgham 把这个词带入炼金术，指汞与另一种金属混成的软膏。

items.en: Medieval Latin amalgama appears in alchemical texts of the thirteenth century, keeping the sense of a workable metallic paste.
items.cn: 中世纪拉丁语 amalgama 见于 13 世纪的炼金术文献，保留「可加工的金属膏」这一含义。

items.en: Old French amalgame passed the word into English in the fifteenth century, still mainly a term of the metal workshop.
items.cn: 古法语 amalgame 在 15 世纪把该词传入英语，当时仍主要是金属作坊的术语。

items.en: From the metal paste English widened amalgam to any blend of styles or ideas, and built amalgamate and amalgamation for the act of merging.
items.cn: 英语从金属膏出发，把 amalgam 扩大到风格或思想的任何混合，并造出 amalgamate 与 amalgamation 表示合并这一动作。

note.en: The look-alike group keeps the amalgam- family and one similar opening; the near-meaning group lists other words for things combined.
note.cn: 形近组保留 amalgam- 词族与一个相近开头；近义组列出其他表示「结合而成之物」的词。

entries.definition: To combine into one body.
entries.definitionCN: 合并成一个整体。

entries.definition: The act of combining.
entries.definitionCN: 合并的行为。

entries.definition: Combined into a single body.
entries.definitionCN: 已合并为一个整体的。

entries.definition: A plant with lasting flowers.
entries.definitionCN: 一种花期很长的植物。

entries.definition: Something made by mixing.
entries.definitionCN: 混合而成的东西。

entries.definition: A smooth combination of parts.
entries.definitionCN: 各部分平滑结合的产物。

entries.definition: A metal made of two or more elements.
entries.definitionCN: 由两种以上元素构成的金属。

entries.definition: Something built from distinct parts.
entries.definitionCN: 由不同部分构成的东西。

normalIntro.en: Amalgam began as a soft metal paste, so picture kneading separate pieces into one lump.
normalIntro.cn: amalgam 起初是软金属膏，所以想象把分散的碎块揉成一团。

normal.en: The fixed pattern is an amalgam of A and B.
normal.cn: 固定格式是「an amalgam of A and B」。

normal.en: The verb is amalgamate, the noun of action amalgamation.
normal.cn: 动词是 amalgamate，动作名词是 amalgamation。

normal.en: Dental amalgam is the silver filling, not the white resin one.
normal.cn: dental amalgam 是银色补牙材料，不是白色树脂那种。

normal.en: Amalgam is countable: an amalgam, two amalgams.
normal.cn: amalgam 可数：an amalgam、two amalgams。

normal.en: Do not confuse amalgam with amaranth, a plant.
normal.cn: 别把 amalgam 与 amaranth「一种植物」混淆。

abstract.en: Picture a grey paste pressed into a tooth.
abstract.cn: 想象一团灰膏被压进一颗牙里。

abstract.en: Imagine two music styles melting into one track.
abstract.cn: 想象两种音乐风格融进同一首曲子。

abstract.en: Think of a city where every street borrowed from somewhere else.
abstract.cn: 想象一座每条街都从别处借来元素的城市。

examples.en: The book is an amalgam of diary and essay.
examples.cn: 这本书是日记与随笔的混合体。

examples.en: Dental amalgam has been used for over a century.
examples.cn: 牙科银汞合金已使用了一个多世纪。

examples.en: Two small firms formed an amalgam to survive.
examples.cn: 两家小公司合并成一个整体以求生存。

dict_mnemonic.text: 谐音「阿妈了 gam」——阿妈（ama）把（l）各（g）样（am）东西揉一起：揉成一团分不出原样，就是混合物、汞合金。

root: 希腊语 malassein「使变软」生出 malagma「软化膏」，阿拉伯语加冠词成 al-malgham，中世纪拉丁语定为 amalgama，指汞与金属揉成的软膏，引申为任何混合体。

sensesIntro.en: Both senses are one soft mass: the technical paste of mercury and metal, and the general blend of anything at all.
sensesIntro.cn: 两个义项是同一团软物质：技术上是汞与金属的膏，一般义是任何东西的混合。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: separate pieces kneaded into one mass
core.cn: 核心意象：分散的碎块被揉成一团

branches.en: A menu borrowing from two regions.
branches.cn: 一份借鉴两地风味的菜单。

branches.en: A film mixing laughter and grief.
branches.cn: 一部混合笑声与悲伤的电影。

branches.en: A silver filling in a back tooth.
branches.cn: 后牙里的银色填充物。

branches.en: Mercury worked into another metal.
branches.cn: 汞被揉进另一种金属。

branches.en: Both lose the shape of their parts.
branches.cn: 两者都失去了各部分的原有形状。

intro.en: Amalgam carries the Arabic article al- and the Greek soft root mal-, and adds -ate and -ation for the verb and its noun.
intro.cn: amalgam 带着阿拉伯语冠词 al- 与希腊语「软」词根 mal-，再加 -ate 与 -ation 构成动词及其名词。

latinIntro.en: The base is Greek malagma, a soft poultice; Arabic added al-, and Medieval Latin fixed the form amalgama before French passed it on.
latinIntro.cn: 底座是希腊语 malagma「软化膏」；阿拉伯语加上 al-，中世纪拉丁语把形式定为 amalgama，再由法语传入。

latinEntries.exampleCN: malassein 是 malagma 的来源。

definition_zh: v. 临时照看小孩（父母外出时）；引申指细心看护需要照料之事
definition_en: To look after a child while its parents are out; by extension, to watch over something that needs careful attention.
core_image: 父母出门后守在摇篮边的那几个小时
scene: 她答应周六晚上替邻居看孩子。 She agreed to babysit for the neighbours on Saturday night.
sceneCN: 第 1 个义项：babysit 指在父母外出期间临时照看小孩。

derivatives.zh: 临时照看孩子这份工作

senses.title: Mind a child for a while
senses.definition: to care for a child in its own home during the absence of its parents
senses.definitionCN: 在父母不在时于孩子家中照料孩子
senses.example: He babysat for his sister twice a week.
senses.exampleCN: 他每周替姐姐看两次孩子。
senses.why: The word was formed backwards from babysitter, so it literally means to sit by a baby.
senses.whyCN: 这个词是由 babysitter 反向构出的，因此字面就是「坐在婴儿旁边」。

senses.title: Watch over something fragile
senses.titleCN: 看护需要细心照料之事
senses.definition: by extension, to give close, patient attention to a task or thing that cannot be left alone
senses.definitionCN: 引申指对不能放任不管的任务或事物给予细致耐心的关注
senses.example: Someone has to babysit the server all night.
senses.exampleCN: 得有人整夜盯着那台服务器。
senses.why: The child picture carries the idea of constant watching, so the verb spread to any job needing a nurse.
senses.whyCN: 看孩子的画面带着「持续守望」之意，于是这个动词扩展到任何需要看护的工作。

intro.en: Babysit is a back-formation from babysitter, recorded in the 1930s; baby is a nursery word and sit is native English, so the verb means to sit by a baby.
intro.cn: babysit 是由 babysitter 反向构词而来，1930 年代有记载；baby 是育儿用语，sit 是英语本族词，因此这个动词意为「坐在婴儿旁边」。

items.en: Babe was a nursery word for an infant, imitating early speech sounds.
items.cn: babe 是指婴儿的育儿用语，模仿早期语音。

items.en: Old English sittan meant to sit, and also to remain in a place attending to something.
items.cn: 古英语 sittan 意为「坐」，也指留在某处照料某事。

items.en: Baby became the ordinary word for a very young child, replacing older native forms.
items.cn: baby 成为指幼儿的常用词，取代了更早的本族形式。

items.en: Baby-sitter is recorded in the 1930s for a person paid to sit with a child.
items.cn: baby-sitter 于 1930 年代有记载，指受雇陪看孩子的人。

items.en: The verb babysit was formed backwards from the noun in the 1940s.
items.cn: 动词 babysit 于 1940 年代由名词反向构出。

items.en: Later in the century the verb spread to machines, projects and fragile processes.
items.cn: 该世纪后期这个动词扩展到机器、项目与易出问题的流程。

note.en: The look-alike group keeps the sit compounds; the near-meaning group lists other words for minding a person or a thing.

entries.definition: To live in a house while owners are away.

entries.definition: To rest on the seat of the body.

entries.definition: One who sits, or poses for a portrait.

entries.definition: To watch over work or people.

normalIntro.en: Babysit is baby plus sit, built backwards from babysitter: sit by the baby until the parents return.
normalIntro.cn: babysit 是 baby 加 sit，由 babysitter 反向构出：坐在婴儿旁边直到父母回来。

normal.en: The past form is babysat, not babysitted.
normal.cn: 过去式是 babysat，不是 babysitted。

normal.en: Babysit for someone, babysit someone directly.
normal.cn: 既可接 for 加人，也可直接接人。

normal.en: The job noun is babysitting.
normal.cn: 工作名词是 babysitting。

normal.en: Housesit follows the same pattern.
normal.cn: housesit 遵循同一构词方式。

normal.en: It extends to servers and projects.

abstract.en: Picture a chair pulled beside a cot.
abstract.cn: 想象一把椅子拉到婴儿床边。

abstract.en: Imagine a lamp left on until a key turns.
abstract.cn: 想象一盏灯亮着直到钥匙转动。

abstract.en: Think of a machine you dare not leave.
abstract.cn: 想象一台你不敢离开的机器。

examples.en: Can you babysit on Friday evening?
examples.cn: 你周五晚上能来看孩子吗？

examples.en: She babysat for three families that year.

examples.en: He had to babysit the printer all morning.

dict_mnemonic.text: 拆件记忆：baby「婴儿」+ sit「坐」——坐在婴儿旁边守着，就是 babysit；过去式跟着 sit 变成 babysat。

root: baby 为育儿用语，sit 出自古英语 sittan「坐、留守」；1930 年代先有 babysitter「陪看孩子的人」，1940 年代反向构出动词 babysit。

sensesIntro.en: Both senses are the same patient sitting: beside a cot until the parents come home, and beside a fragile task until it is safe.
sensesIntro.cn: 两个义项都是同一种耐心守坐：守在婴儿床边直到父母回家，守在易出问题的任务旁直到它稳妥。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: the hours kept beside a cot after the parents go out
core.cn: 核心意象：父母出门后守在摇篮边的那几个小时

branches.en: A Saturday night for the neighbours.
branches.cn: 替邻居守的周六夜晚。

branches.en: Twice a week for a sister.
branches.cn: 每周两次替姐姐看孩子。

branches.en: A server watched all night.
